svg.title: Absorption spectrum and observed colour
svg.desc: Visible spectrum bar and absorption curves of yellow, red and blue dyes with their apparent colours
svg.text: Why a dye looks coloured: absorption of part of the visible spectrum
Visible region 400–700 nm; the eye sees what is NOT absorbed
Photon energy E = hν = hc/λ ≈ 1240 / λ(nm) eV. Absorbed band + colour seen are complementary (see colour wheel).
